title: MKA/MACsec: various optimizations
description:
For both:
- Treat the name as a C-string, preventing unwanted conversions, and
simplify string handling.
- Use ws_strdup() when no formatting is required.

For MKA:
- Update UAT defaults, so that existing UAT files (from 4.4) can be read
in without error.
- Present unwrapped SAK correctly, not referencing ICV in packet bytes.

commits_data.message:
MKA/MACsec: various optimizations

For both:
- Treat the name as a C-string, preventing unwanted conversions, and
simplify string handling.
- Use ws_strdup() when no formatting is required.
For MKA:
- Update UAT defaults, so that existing UAT files (from 4.4) can be read
in without error.
- Present unwrapped SAK correctly, not referencing ICV in packet bytes.
